name: Sirius' Swaddle Syandana
description: Swaddling cloth of the infant Sirius, worn as a ragged badge of honor.

languages.description: Fascia per il piccolo Sirius, indossato come distintivo d'onore.
languages.name: Syandana Sirius' Swaddle

languages.description: 갓난아기였던 시리우스를 감쌌던 포대기 천으로, 너덜너덜해졌지만 명예의 상징으로써 몸에 두르고 있습니다.

languages.description: ผ้าห่อตัวทารก Sirius ที่ใช้เป็นเครื่องหมายของตราเกียรติยศที่ขาดวิ่น
languages.name: ไซอันดานา Sirius' Swaddle

languages.description: Yıpranmış bir onur madalyası niyetine kullanılan, bebek Sirius'a ait bir kundak bezi.

languages.description: Шматок пелюшки немовляти Сіріуса, який став розідраним знаком шани.
